- **Total Liabilities Assumed**: $85 million (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Total Assets Acquired**: $195 million (Source: documents/report.md)
- **Real Estate Investments**: $162 million (Source: documents/report.md)

\[ \text{Leverage} = \frac{\text{Total Liabilities Assumed}}{\text{Total Assets Acquired}} = \frac{85}{195} \approx 0.436 \]
